name: Louie's Legacy Animal Rescue (NY)
neighborhoods: Staten Island NY base (also Ohio); serves NY/NJ/CT Northeast
region_note: STATEN ISLAND (Staten Island-based / SI-serving dog rescues)
notes: 501(c)(3), one of the nation's largest foster-based rescues, with bases in Ohio and NYC. NY office 3204 Amboy Rd, Staten Island 10306. Foster-based - no walk-in shelter; meet dogs at weekend adoption events (check FB for weekly album + event locations). Dogs come fully vetted, spayed/neutered, microchipped, heartworm-tested; age/breed/size not guaranteed (shelter origin). Post-adoption support team. Application at the link; high volume, so not every applicant is contacted.
